description: DBAL OIDC login credentials for pastebin's demo/test users (Argon2id, via dbal::security::hash_password) -- these are the only real credentials for pastebin now; the C++/Drogon backend has no local password store, and pastebin_users.json's passwordHash field is vestigial (left over from the old Flask backend, which is gone). "id" holds the username (see credential.json) -- deliberately "demo-pastebin", not "demo", since Credential.id is a single global namespace and "demo" is already taken by the system-tenant bootstrap account (credentials.json). Same documented plaintexts as pastebin_users.json: demo-pastebin=demo1234, alice=alice1234, bob=bob12345, playwright=pw-test-2024.
